Understand the next step

What to know before you contact the team

Who this is for

Existing patients who have received an approved referral-program message and can provide appropriate consent before any submission.

What to expect

  • Publish eligibility, qualifying visit, reward, new-patient benefit, timing, caps, expiry, stacking, and disclosures.
  • Use a consent-aware submission path that does not disclose health interest or contact a friend without permission.
  • Send `referral_submit_success` only after an approved backend confirms receipt.

Limitations and boundaries

  • No referral form, reward, code, eligibility, or benefit is active here.
  • Referral friend data and free-text content must never enter the analytics data layer.
  • The program requires qualified legal/compliance review before promotion.

Questions patients ask

Before you decide

Can I refer a friend from this preview?

No. The referral route is a noindex draft and is not accepting submissions.

What must the program disclose?

Eligibility, qualifying action, reward/benefit, timing, caps, expiry, stacking, consent, and applicable disclosures must be approved before release.

When should the success event fire?

Only after the approved referral backend confirms receipt; never on submit-button click alone.
